notes: State expectations come from games/dice-relic/tests/model.py, whose combat, prices and PRNG are upstream model.py (jr100dev games/dice_relic 1.7.1) and whose selection, workshop and menu follow upstream src/main.asm, not from the emulator. The PRNG seed is the title song position when RETURN starts the game; every replay starts with RETURN at the same cycle, and the model starts from the seed the emulator took (state byte 10). synthetic-nine-battles plays upstream replay.py's policy through all nine battles and the workshop. A defeat cannot be reached by replay (healing or guarding with every die outlasts every guardian); tests/test_dice_relic.py checks it on the model. Key gaps leave 42000 cycles per effect frame and 750000 per roll. synthetic-title and synthetic-nine-battles require a PCM peak of 21000.
